summary: The model is the single source of truth that keeps argspec and docstring in sync; the builder generates the scaffold, argspec and docstring, and future changes start by updating the model.
questions: How do I change a resource module's options later?
What does the builder generate from a model?

answer_card.title: The resource model
answer_card.answer_md: From an approved model the builder generates the module scaffold, the argspec and the docstring. For later changes, edit the model first, then rerun the builder to update argspec and docstring so they stay in sync.
